CheckTitle: CCE clusters do not expose public API endpoints
Description: Ensure that CCE clusters do not have public API endpoints exposed to the internet.
Risk: A public API endpoint allows the Kubernetes API server to be accessed from the internet, increasing the risk of unauthorized cluster access and control plane compromise.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Cloud Container Engine.
3. Select the cluster.
4. Disable the public API endpoint or restrict access to specific CIDR ranges.
5. Access the cluster only via VPC or VPN.

Recommendation.Text: Disable public API endpoints for CCE clusters and restrict access to private networks only.

Notes: Checks if CCE clusters have external endpoints exposed to the internet.
